name: Related client stories (content)
purpose: Keeps a reader moving through content-library case studies by linking three other customer stories at the end of one.
description: Hairline-bordered block on the content ("yellow") theme: a left-aligned serif 4rem H2 header row, then a 3-column grid (1 column at 767 and below) of fixed-aspect cards, each with a customer logo, a one-sentence summary and a "Learn more ›" link to that case study. Not a slider.
